screen.reason: The paper presents the design and empirical evaluation (load testing and a 35-participant pilot user acceptance study) of Maand, a multimodal AI mental health platform integrating Gemini, computer vision, and crisis interception safety filters, but does not isolate or comparatively test a deployment practice.
